svg.title: EthenaPay cashback paid for September 2026 against each wallet's card payments, with the three tier schedules
svg.desc: The chart has 580 dots, one per EthenaPay wallet with $10 or more of card payments from September 1 to 28, 2026 and cashback paid in the batches from September 3 to October 1, placed by its card payments on a log scale from $10 to $200,000 and its cashback in dollars, at the Chainlink AVAX / USD price in force at each transfer, on a log scale from $0.10 to $3,000. Three lines show what each tier's schedule pays for a month's spend. Standard pays 4% to $2,500 and 1% to $4,000, then nothing, so it stops at $115. Pro pays 4.5% to $8,000 and VIP 5% to $20,000, with lower rates above. Light-spending wallets sit close to the Standard line. Twenty-eight wallets with $4,041.18 to $47,552.73 of card payments from September 1 to 28 sit on the flat Standard line, paid $109.39 to $119.92. Of the other wallets with $4,000 or more, 12 sit within 5% of the VIP line, among them the largest-spending wallet, $126,019.43 in September and $1,688.76 of cashback, and 6 within 5% of the Pro line.
svg.text: Twenty-eight heavy-spending wallets were paid about $115, the Standard tier's ceiling
Each dot is a wallet, its card payments September 1 to 28 against its cashback paid September 3 to October 1
Card payments, September 1 to 28, USDe, log scale
Cashback paid, $ at Chainlink's AVAX price, log scale
Transfers on Avalanche C-Chain, read to the end of October 9 UTC. Schedules, Ethena Pay Pricing page, Section 3.1.
